race.description: Quirindi Boxing Day Races Mdn Plate
race.comment: GOD'S WINTER ROSE (7) is a Danerich mare on debut for the Smith camp. Showed positive signs in her Beaumont trial performance and Heavelon VDH can have her blending in at the right time from the kind draw. Bright start anticipated. NORDIC STAR (8) looks best of the raced bunch and resumes with two handy trials under her belt that suggest she's come on well during the break. Nock will need to be clever from the wide draw. FROG ROCK (5) just missed when resuming at Muswellbrook, but was no match for them last time. Tough to tip with confidence, but is worth keeping safe for a minor spot. CLARRY'S RUN (1) is another debutant that has shown enough in his two trials to deserve consideration.
